messages:
Lena: 5-minute lunch skill idea — if you had to teach the office one totally useless but oddly impressive skill in a 5-min lunchtime demo, what would it be? I'll start: folding a napkin into a tiny top hat. (yes, it's niche)
Marco: How to peel a kiwi with one swipe and not lose half the fruit. show-and-tell optional. :kiwi:
Anika: Balancing a paperclip chain on your finger. I can do 23 before it collapses. :sweat_smile:
Devon: The ancient art of convincing the office coffee machine to give you a clean cup (step 1: sweet-talk it)
Ravi: Quick card flourish — the one-handed shuffle. Will bring a deck. 5 mins is tight but doable.
Becky: How to microwave leftovers without turning them into a volcano. science + Tupperware hacks.
Lena: Love these. @Marco — demo at 12:15?
Marco: @Lena yes. I'll bring a kiwi and a towel. also consider an applause emoji for bravery :clap:
Anika: If we're doing props, can I teach the napkin hat AND the paperclip chain together? mashup.
Devon: Also lol at microwave volcano mitigation. I have a rice trick that works every time.
Ravi: Will record quick phone vid for posterity (or blackmail later). :camera:
ops-bot: Reminder: All-hands in 30m. Don't forget lunch skill demos might need to be quick.
Becky: Can we make this a weekly 5-min slot? 'Tiny Tricks Tuesday' or whatever.
Lena: Tiny Tricks Tuesday is a great name. @everyone, show up with 1 prop and 1 (very) short demo idea. I'll make a poll tomorrow for day/time. :sparkles:
Marco: voted mentally. :thumbsup:
Anika: I'll bring glitter-free napkins.
Devon: i'll bring the Tupperware.
Ravi: noted. see you at lunch.
